# Mumotor — Full Logical-Correctness Audit Report

> **✅ REMEDIATED (2026-07-11).** Every finding below (3 CRITICAL, ~14 HIGH, ~30 MEDIUM, and the
> LOW/COSMETIC/SPEC items) was fixed on branch `fix/audit-2026-07` and merged to `main`. Suites green:
> integration 74/74 · frontend unit 27/27 · E2E 90/90; headline fixes were re-confirmed live. See the
> `audit-remediation-july-2026` memory + the `fix(...)` commits for the per-wave breakdown. This document
> is retained as the record of what was found.


*Generated by a deep, wave-based "act-like-a-real-user" audit of the entire product. Method: exhaustive
code-trace of every flow (frontend + backend + DB rules) by parallel specialist agents, plus live
runtime spot-checks of the highest-risk paths. **No source code was changed** — this is an
investigation and reporting deliverable only.*

**Reference spec:** `WHAT_MUMOTOR_DOES.md` (the plain-English description of everything Mumotor claims to
do). Findings check whether the product actually behaves as that document claims, and whether each flow
is internally correct even where the doc is silent.

**Date:** 2026-07-10 · **Scope:** marketing site · auth · builder wizard · Customize editor · all 12
templates · student flows · teacher dashboard · admin · emails · cron · trilingual HE/AR/EN + RTL ·
backend rules (booking, double-booking, isolation, rate limits).

---

## How to read a finding

Each finding is written as: **what a user does → what SHOULD happen → what ACTUALLY happens →
root cause (`file:line`) → severity**. Every claim is traceable to cited code; items marked
**[LIVE]** were additionally confirmed by running the app (see Wave 6).

**Severity legend:** `CRITICAL` (blocks a core flow / security takeover) · `HIGH` (feature broken or
data wrong for many users) · `MEDIUM` (broken in a common sub-case, or misleading) · `LOW` (edge case /
robustness) · `SPEC` (behaviour disagrees with `WHAT_MUMOTOR_DOES.md`) · `COSMETIC`.

---

## Executive summary

The product is broadly well-built: multi-tenant isolation, the DB-level double-booking guarantee,
rate limiting, token separation, and the packages↔plans single-source-of-truth are all genuinely
correct and held up under adversarial review. But the audit found a number of real, user-visible
defects — including several that break a core flow or silently corrupt user-facing data.

### Severity tally

| Severity | Count | Headliners |
|---|---:|---|
| **CRITICAL** | 3 | Wizard "create account & publish" is broken (phone omitted); student login = email-only takeover; lesson-reminder cron fires *after* the lesson (timezone) |
| **HIGH** | ~14 | City duplicated on every published site; date drift breaks daily emails + enrollment codes nightly; deleting a student orphans their bookings; "Lessons booked" tile counts cancelled forever; emails are English-only; Customize "Saved" lies on failure; templates drop the transmission chip; HE/AR slugs collapse to `driving-school` |
| **MEDIUM** | ~30 | Clearing price/experience silently fails; enroll code case-sensitivity; frosted black-on-black booking pages; review-reply CSS dead in all templates; cron duplicate-send + no error isolation; many i18n leaks |
| **LOW / COSMETIC / SPEC** | ~35 | RTL arrow mirroring, dead code, spec drift, robustness |

### The five things to fix first

1. **Wizard publish-while-signed-out is dead** (CRITICAL) — every brand-new teacher who signs up *at
   the moment of publishing* gets a 400 and is stuck. `#C1`.
2. **Nightly timezone drift** (CRITICAL/HIGH) — reminder emails fire after the lesson; the daily
   "booking is open" email shows the wrong date and freshly-issued enrollment codes are rejected, for
   default-config schools, every night. `#C3`, `#H2`.
3. **City duplicated on published sites** (HIGH) — the contact address and areas repeat the city for
   essentially every teacher who fills in both Address and City. `#H1`.
4. **Deleting a student orphans their bookings** (HIGH) — the slot is blocked forever and the ghost
   booking bleeds onto whoever re-enrolls with that email. `#H5`.
5. **Student login is email-only** (CRITICAL security) — anyone who knows a student's email gets a
   30-day session. `#C2`.

---

# CRITICAL findings

### C1 — The wizard's "Create account & publish" step can never register a new teacher
**Flow:** Builder → Design → Publish (while signed out) → Register → submit.
**SHOULD:** create the account and immediately publish (spec Part 3, Step 4a).
**ACTUALLY:** the request is rejected with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the account is never created,
`doPublish()` never fires, and the teacher is stuck on the account screen with a generic "Validation
failed" toast.
**Root cause:** the backend `registerSchema` **requires** `phone` (`packages/backend/src/routes/auth.ts:19-25`,
no `.optional()`), but the wizard's embedded `AccountStep` collects only `{name,email,password}` and
never sends `phone` (`packages/frontend/src/pages/builder/BuilderWizard.tsx:846,853`). The *standalone*
`Register.tsx` correctly collects phone — the wizard's copy was never updated when "phone required at
signup" shipped (July 5). The Login branch of the same step works. **Every brand-new teacher who
publishes while signed out is blocked.** **[LIVE:** no-phone register → `400 VALIDATION_ERROR
{phone:["Required"]}`; with phone → `201`.**]** **Severity: CRITICAL.**

### C2 — Student portal login requires only an email address (account takeover)
**Flow:** `POST /driving-school/:websiteId/student/login {email}` — no password, no code, no magic link.
**SHOULD:** logging in as a specific student should require proof of identity (the codebase's own
`proveStudentIdentity` requires email + enrollment code elsewhere).
**ACTUALLY:** if the email is an ACTIVE enrollment, the handler immediately mints a **30-day** student
JWT (`drivingSchool.ts:1174-1197`, `middleware/auth.ts:11-14`). Anyone who knows/guesses a student's
email can view their lessons, phone, and chat, cancel lessons, and edit their phone — for 30 days,
renewable. The `signStudentToken` comment says "short-lived", but it is 30 days. Documented as
intentional in CLAUDE.md, but it is an authentication bypass by any standard definition and pairs with
`#H8` (email enumeration) for one-request takeover.
**[LIVE:** `POST /student/login {email:"anna@example.com"}` (no secret) → `200` + JWT → `/student/me`
returned the full account.**]** **Severity: CRITICAL (security).**

### C3 — Lesson-reminder & review-request cron fire *after* the lesson (timezone inversion)
**Flow:** the every-15-min job that sends "your lesson is soon" reminders and "how was your lesson"
review requests.
**SHOULD:** reminder ~2h before the lesson (Israel wall-clock); review request ~1h after it ends.
**ACTUALLY:** `lessonDateTime()` (`packages/backend/src/services/jobs/jobService.ts:20-26`) reads the
stored Israel-local `bookingTime` string and mislabels it as **UTC** (`setUTCHours`), then compares it
to a real-UTC `new Date()`. Israel is UTC+2/+3, so in summer (IDT) the "2h before" reminder only fires
**1–3 hours after the lesson has already started**; with the default 60-min lesson it's typically over
by the time the reminder sends. Review requests are delayed ~3–4h (tolerated by a 3-day window). The
correct pattern already exists two files over (`drivingSchool.ts:82-85`, `minutesUntilLesson`, uses
`nowInZone`). **The lesson-reminder feature is effectively inverted.**
**Severity: CRITICAL (a headline feature silently doesn't work).**

---

# HIGH findings

### H1 — Every published site duplicates the city in the contact address and areas
**Flow:** Business step → fill both **Address** and **City** (the documented, expected path) → publish.
**SHOULD:** address shows once, e.g. "22 Jabotinsky Street, Netanya".
**ACTUALLY (executed/verified):** the published site shows "22 Jabotinsky Street, Netanya, **Netanya**"
and the Areas list gets a duplicate "Netanya" chip — while the *in-wizard preview* shows it correctly
(a preview ≠ published divergence). `toBusinessConfig` combines `[address, city]` into `contact.address`
**and** stores `city` separately (`packages/frontend/src/lib/wizard.ts:301-328`); then
`publicToTemplateData` feeds the already-combined address + city back into `buildTemplateData`, which
combines them **again** (`packages/frontend/src/templates/fromWizard.ts:156,368-369`). Also appears in
the schema.org JSON-LD (`PublicSite.tsx:94`) and the dashboard Customize editor. The existing test uses
the exact failure precondition but never asserts on the address, so it slips through.
**[LIVE:** live DOM showed contact text `"22 Herzl Street, Netanya, Netanya"`, JSON-LD `areaServed` with
"Netanya" twice, and two area chips both "Netanya".**]** **Severity: HIGH.**

### H1b — Areas "Home base" shows the street instead of the city
Same root as H1: `buildAreas` takes `parts[0]` of `[address, city]` (address-first), so the first area
card ("Home base") reads the **street** ("22 Jabotinsky Street") while the hero eyebrow correctly says
"in Netanya" — an internal inconsistency in one function (`fromWizard.ts:94-101,155`). **HIGH.**

### H2 — Nightly date drift: daily "booking open" email shows the wrong date; fresh enrollment codes rejected
**Flow:** the every-5-min "daily rhythm" cron + the enroll route, around Israel midnight.
**SHOULD:** all "today/tomorrow" dates computed in Israel time.
**ACTUALLY:** `todayUtcMidnight()`/`tomorrowUtcMidnight()` (`packages/backend/src/utils/time.ts:79-89`)
ignore `APP_TIMEZONE`. For the default `bookingWindowStart='00:00'` cohort (the majority of sites), the
first tick after Israel-midnight lands in the ~2–3h window where the UTC date hasn't rolled yet, so:
- The "booking is open for tomorrow" email states **today's** date, not tomorrow's
  (`jobService.ts:106`) — once per day, no self-correction (`markSent`).
- A student redeeming the daily code they were just emailed gets `INVALID_CODE`, because the cron stored
  the code under the Israel date but `/enroll` looks it up under the UTC date
  (`jobService.ts:222` vs `drivingSchool.ts:132`).
- Also skews `schedule/assign`, `email-me`, the Today/Tomorrow toggle, and student stats around midnight.
**Severity: HIGH.**

### H3 — Emails are English-only regardless of the site's language
**SHOULD:** student-facing emails in the site's locale (HE/AR/EN); the `Website.locale` field exists for
exactly this and the linked web pages are localized.
**ACTUALLY:** `emailService.ts` has **zero** i18n — every template ("Your lesson is confirmed",
"Lesson reminder", "Booking is now open", the teacher's daily report, etc.) is hardcoded English, and no
caller ever reads `website.locale`. Since `locale` defaults to HE, the majority of teachers and students
receive all transactional emails in English with raw ISO dates ("2026-07-10") instead of the localized
long date. **Severity: HIGH (spec + product).**

### H4 — The uploaded school logo never appears in any email
`resolveLogoUrl()` (`emailService.ts:41-46`) discards `data:` URIs and only accepts http(s)/relative
URLs — but the only logo-upload widget in the product stores the logo as a base64 `data:` URI
(`BuilderWizard.tsx:387-419`) and never uploads it via the media API. So `logoUrl` is `undefined` on
every email and the header silently falls back to the plain school name. The feature is wired end-to-end
but has no data path feeding it. **HIGH.**

### H5 — Deleting a student orphans their future bookings and bleeds onto re-enrollment
`DELETE /students/:enrollmentId` only deletes the enrollment row (`drivingSchool.ts:822-832`).
`Booking` has **no FK** to `ClientEnrollment` — it's matched by the `customerEmail` string — so the
student's future CONFIRMED bookings stay alive and **block the slot forever**. Worse: `studentEmail` is
unique only while the row exists, so anyone who re-enrolls with that email gets a new enrollment but the
booking-derived views (stats, my-lessons) match by email and surface the **old** booking they never made
(and can cancel it). `Message` cascades but `Booking` doesn't — inconsistent cleanup. **HIGH.**

### H6 — "Lessons booked" tile counts cancelled lessons forever
The Overview stat reads `website._count.bookings` with no status filter
(`packages/backend/src/routes/websites.ts:70,117`; rendered `Dashboard.tsx:106`). Cancelling only flips
`status` to `CANCELLED` (`drivingSchool.ts:846,1108`), so cancelled/no-show bookings are counted as
"booked" and the number only ever grows. **[LIVE:** booked → `_count.bookings` 2→3; cancelled that
booking → still **3**.**]** **HIGH.**

### H7 — Customize "Save" reports success even when the save fails, then Done discards the edit
`doSave` fires `onSave` **without awaiting** it and stamps `savedRef` as saved on the next synchronous
line (`packages/frontend/src/components/customize/CustomizeMode.tsx:372-378`). The dashboard save awaits
`websiteApi.update` and only shows an error toast on failure. Because "saved" is already stamped, `Done`
sees no diff and navigates away **without the unsaved-changes confirm**, silently losing the edit — the
only signal is a missable toast. **HIGH.**

### H8 — Email enumeration + name disclosure (feeds C2)
Public unauthenticated `GET /check-enrollment?email=` returns `{enrolled, active, status, studentName}`
(`drivingSchool.ts:295-317`), enumerating which emails are enrolled and leaking the real name — the
confirmed email then feeds straight into the email-only login (`#C2`). Rate-limited 10/60s only.
**[LIVE:** real email → `{enrolled:true,studentName:"Anna Krause"}`; random → `{enrolled:false}`.**]** **HIGH.**

### H9 — Dashboard editor loses the teacher's real instructor photo
`CustomizePage.tsx:23-42` builds the editor input but never copies `cfg.instructorPhoto`, so
`buildTemplateData` falls back to the Unsplash stock photo (`fromWizard.ts:184`). The teacher opens
Customize and sees a stranger's photo — may re-upload needlessly or overwrite the good one. The field
*is* persisted (`wizard.ts:334`); this is an editor data-fidelity regression. **HIGH.**

### H10 — Builder-mode Customize uploads become multi-MB base64 blobs
Builder Customize never receives a `websiteId`, so image uploads fall back to a base64 `data:` URI
instead of the media API (`CustomizeMode.tsx:364-370`; `BuilderWizard.tsx:166-182` omits the prop).
`stripDraftImages` doesn't look inside `customization.fields`, so the server draft autosave silently
starts failing, and at publish the blob is embedded permanently in `Website.configuration`. **HIGH.**

### H11 — The transmission / credential chip is dropped entirely on several templates
The teacher's manual/automatic/both chip lives in `instructor.credentials`. **Aurora** and **Prism**
never render `credentials` at all (zero references); **Frosted** renders only the first 3 (`.slice(0,3)`),
dropping the 4th. So a core, deliberately-localized data point simply doesn't appear on 2–3 of the 12
designs. (`aurora/index.tsx`, `prism/index.tsx`, `frosted/index.tsx:172`.) **HIGH.**

### H12 — full-throttle: ~17 fields are silently un-editable in Customize
full-throttle has 49 `data-edit` tags vs 66–67 on its siblings. Package badge/unit/duration, every About
paragraph after the first, instructor title, footer business name/tagline, and the contact phone/email/
address **text** are all un-tagged — so a teacher on this template cannot click-to-edit most of their
About copy, footer, or contact details. **HIGH.**

### H13 — HE/AR sites with a blank tagline print the same sentence twice
For `en`, the hero headline falls back to a distinct sample sentence; for HE/AR there is no localized
hero-headline default, so both the header tagline and the giant hero headline fall back to
`taglineDefault` and render the **identical** sentence twice
(`fromWizard.ts:175,190`; `strings.ts` `DATA_DEFAULTS` has no `heroHeadline`). **HIGH (visible on the page).**

### H14 — Every Hebrew/Arabic-named site gets the slug `driving-school`
`slugify()` keeps only `a-z0-9` (`packages/backend/src/utils/slug.ts:1-10`); Hebrew/Arabic business names
reduce to `''` → fallback `driving-school`, then `driving-school-2`, etc. The wizard never supplies a
slug. Since HE is the default locale — the primary demographic — nearly every site gets a meaningless,
colliding public URL (and, once subdomains ship, subdomain). **HIGH.**

# MEDIUM findings

### Booking / scheduling
- **M1 — `classCount` double-counts and never decrements.** Incremented on every book/assign
  (`drivingSchool.ts:476,960`), never decremented on cancel; the codebase itself documents the column
  "double-counts" and `studentStats` recomputes from rows — but the teacher-facing "Classes" column and
  "Lesson #N" still show the raw column (`:706,883`; `DrivingSchool.tsx:313,609`). Book/cancel×3 → shows
  "Classes: 6" for 1 real lesson. **[LIVE:** after book+cancel, `/student/me` returned `classCount:5`
  alongside the correct `stats.total:1` in the same response.**]**
- **M2 — book-lesson & public-availability authorize by email alone** (`drivingSchool.ts:375-522`) — no
  code/session, unlike every other student write. Anyone knowing an enrolled email can book slots in that
  student's name, spam confirmation emails, and inflate `classCount` (same-tenant, not cross-tenant).
- **M3 — Students can still self-cancel via direct API** (`drivingSchool.ts:1082-1127,1259-1297`) despite
  the documented "students cannot cancel" policy; the UI removed the button but the endpoints are live.
- **M4 — Manual "add student to slot" has no same-day-duplicate guard** — a teacher can assign the same
  active student to two slots the same day with no warning (`drivingSchool.ts:899-966`). (May be intentional.)
- **M5 — `public-availability` ignores `advanceBookingDays`** (`:320-373`) — returns slots 30 days out that
  then fail to book. Not UI-reachable today. **[LIVE:** 30-days-out (site cap 14) → availability returned
  real slots; same date to `/book-lesson` → `400 ADVANCE_BOOKING_EXCEEDED`.**]**

### Cron / emails
- **M6 — No `noOverlap` on either cron** (`jobService.ts:253,258`; node-cron default off). Read-all →
  sequential await-send → mark-sent, no lock → a long tick can overlap and **duplicate-send** (the daily
  "booking open" mail to *every* active student).
- **M7 — No per-item error isolation in the tick loops** (`jobService.ts:38-53,216-235`) — one throw (bad
  config JSON, write failure) skips every item after it that tick; a persistent failure starves the rest
  indefinitely. Also send-then-mark isn't atomic → re-send on the next tick if the flag write fails.
- **M8 — bulk-email with `enrollmentIds: []` emails EVERYONE** (`drivingSchool.ts:1471-1506`) — empty array
  falls through to the default "all" group. UI blocks it, but the backend should 400.

### Customize / wizard
- **M9 — Deleting all packages doesn't stick** — the remove button has no min-length guard; empty
  `packages` → `plans:[]` → `plansToPackages` regenerates the default "Single lesson" on reload
  (`CustomizeMode.tsx:473`; `fromWizard.ts:60-61,273-281`).
- **M10 — Uncommitted text can commit to the wrong list item** after a list add/remove shifts the array
  (`CustomizeMode.tsx:450-476`) — silent content mis-attribution. PLAUSIBLE.
- **M11 — Wizard images bypass the media/CDN pipeline** — logo/car/instructor/gallery stored as raw base64
  in `Website.configuration`, returned on every public load and Redis-cached (`wizard.ts:332-335`). Bloated
  DB rows + cache; unbounded gallery count; no server-side size limit.
- **M12 — Photo upload can silently break localStorage autosave** — `saveWizard` writes the whole config
  (incl. base64 photos) into one key in a `try/catch` that swallows `QuotaExceededError`
  (`wizard.ts:259-266`); a refresh then reloads an older snapshot, losing the photo and later edits.

### Dashboard
- **M13 — Clearing price / experience / pass-rate silently fails but shows "Settings saved"**
  (`DrivingSchool.tsx:911-913`): cleared field = `null` → `null ?? undefined` → key dropped by axios →
  backend keeps old value → response reflects old value. The teacher can never remove these once set.
- **M14 — Enrollment-link buttons are shown for unpublished sites** and lead to a "not found" page
  (`Dashboard.tsx:115`, `DrivingSchool.tsx:125,942`) — no `{live &&}` guard; `public-settings` 404s until
  published. Teacher shares a dead link with no warning.
- **M15 — Reviews Delete has no confirmation** (`Reviews.tsx:122-128`) — irreversible hard-delete on a
  single click, unlike Students/Website delete which both confirm. Also double-fires (no disabled-while-pending).
- **M16 — Assign-to-slot doesn't refresh the Students tab class count** (`DrivingSchool.tsx:504-514` only
  invalidates the report) — stale for up to 30s.

### Student pages
- **M17 — Enroll code case-handling is inconsistent between the two enroll forms (mixed-case codes only).**
  **[LIVE — downgraded from HIGH.]** The static-code comparison is *correctly* case-sensitive
  (`drivingSchool.ts:128-129`) — Wave 6 confirmed lowercase is rightly rejected, so this is **not** a bypass.
  The residual issue: the standalone `Enroll.tsx` uppercases the code as typed (`:34-35`) but the book-lesson
  inline enroll reads it raw (`BookLesson.tsx:265,280`), so a teacher who saves a **mixed-case** custom code
  (e.g. "Drive2026") would have it succeed on one form and fail on the other. Default regenerated codes are
  all-uppercase, so this only bites manually-typed mixed-case codes. **Downgraded to LOW.**
- **M18 — Frosted Customize "Text" override → black-on-black booking pages.** `SHELL_VARS.frosted.ink`
  maps to `--fr-ink` (#0B1220, "text on light cards") instead of the template's real body text var
  `--fr-white` (`templateTheme.ts:31`; `frosted.css:6,27,80`). Only frosted mismatches. Customizing the
  Text swatch makes near-black text on the dark booking background across enroll/book/account/review.
- **M19 — Enroll doesn't distinguish active vs paused** — a paused student re-enrolling gets the cheerful
  "already enrolled" success card while `autoSignIn` silently 403s (`Enroll.tsx:64-67`).
- **M20 — Server error messages bypass localization on all four student pages** — every non-special
  `onError` toasts the raw English backend string ("Invalid enrollment code", "Your account is paused…",
  "That slot was just taken") mid-HE/AR UI.
- **M21 — StudentAccount infinite spinner on any non-401 error** (`StudentAccount.tsx:178-191`) — only 401
  is handled; a 500/network blip/RATE_LIMITED leaves a permanent unlabeled spinner, no retry.
- **M22 — "Book another lesson" shows a stale slot list** (`BookLesson.tsx:163-174`) — availability isn't
  invalidated on success, only on 409, so within 30s the just-taken slot is still selectable.

### Templates
- **M23 — Review-reply block is unstyled in ALL 12 templates** — the CSS defines `.xx-review-reply-reply`
  (doubled suffix) but the JSX uses `.xx-review-reply`, so a teacher's public reply renders as a bare
  paragraph with no indent/border/dimming (confirmed on all 8 templates read in detail; pattern is
  identical across the set except `prism`, which uses a differently-named class and is unaffected).
  **[LIVE:** computed style on `.mm-review-reply` showed `border-inline-start:0px`, `padding-inline-start:0px`,
  label `font-weight:400` — the `.xx-review-reply-reply` CSS never matches.**]**
- **M24 — Obsidian renders a blank glass badge when stats are empty** (`obsidian/index.tsx:268-279`, not
  gated on `stats.length` unlike its siblings).
- **M25 — Dead "Book now" placeholder button** on all 4 group-1 templates — when `bookingUrl` is unset the
  fallback `<button>` has no `disabled`/`aria-disabled`/`onClick` but keeps hover styling (invites a click
  that does nothing; tooltip invisible on touch).
- **M26 — FAQ keyed by question text (night-shift, prestige)** and **stats keyed by label (full-throttle,
  open-road)** — editing text remounts the `Reveal` wrapper (`whileInView` can stick at opacity:0); two
  blank FAQs collide on `key=""` with shared open-state (opening one opens both). Violates the repo's own
  documented "never key by content" rule.
- **M27 — `pkg.lessons` dropped on night-shift & prestige** — a "10 lessons" package looks identical to a
  single lesson; full-throttle/easy-lane render it.
- **M28 — Package duration line not editable** in full-throttle & easy-lane (no `data-edit`).
- **M29 — grid-ink footer omits the business name** — a JSX comment where the name should be
  (`grid-ink/index.tsx:604`).
- **M30 — Package "selection" state is discarded before Booking** (grid-ink, open-road) — the card
  highlights "Selected" then scrolls to a booking section that never receives the selection.

### Auth / app
- **M31 — 401 doesn't sign the user out until a hard reload** — the axios interceptor clears the token but
  never notifies `AuthContext`, so protected pages keep rendering a broken session (`api.ts:41-53`,
  `auth.tsx:20-34`, `ProtectedRoute.tsx`).
- **M32 — `change-password` is not rate-limited** (`auth.ts:115-129`) — a stolen teacher JWT can brute-force
  the current password with no throttle.

# LOW / COSMETIC / SPEC findings

- **L1** Reset/verify tokens stored as the raw token string as the KV key, not hashed (`auth.ts:41,175`) —
  not brute-forceable but inconsistent with the codebase's "never plaintext" principle.
- **L2** Login timing oracle — no-user path skips bcrypt, revealing account existence via latency
  (`auth.ts:75-88`).
- **L3** `forgot-password`/`resend-verification` return `{sent:true}` even when the internal per-email cap
  suppressed the send — reads as "never got the email" for the authenticated resend path (`auth.ts:145-184`).
- **L4** Slug has no reserved-word denylist (`admin`/`api`/`mumotor` etc.) — dormant until subdomains ship.
- **L5** `PATCH /websites/:id` doesn't invalidate the manifest/icon cache — installed PWA shows the old
  accent/name up to 5 min after a Customize save (`websites.ts:126-149`).
- **L6** `WebsiteVersion` snapshots are write-only (created every publish, never read/pruned) — unbounded
  growth; concurrent publish can duplicate version numbers.
- **L7** No `PUBLISHED` check on public mutations (enroll/book/availability/review) — a DRAFT site's UUID
  can still receive enrollments/bookings/pending reviews.
- **L8** `SUSPENDED` enrollment status is dead code (filterable/emailable but never set).
- **L9** Malformed non-UUID path params surface as raw 500s (PrismaClientValidationError not caught).
- **L10** Student session tokens aren't re-validated against live status — a paused/completed student keeps
  full access for up to 30 days (`loadStudentEnrollment` never checks ACTIVE); legacy email+code endpoints
  also skip the status check.
- **L11** No dashboard path to un-complete a student — accidental "Mark completed" is only undoable by
  delete (→ triggers H5).
- **L12** Analytics funnel is gameable — `POST /events` is unauthenticated with a client-issued session id,
  so `wizardStarted` can be inflated while `published` is trustworthy (asymmetric ratio).
- **L13** Subject-line header-injection surface — the school name is sanitized for the `From` header but not
  the subject (`emailService.ts:302,429`).
- **L14** Icon picker is ~130 curated icons, not the "full lucide library" the docs claim; `iconExists()`
  always returns false (dead code) (`DynamicIcon.tsx:18-22,45-110`).
- **L15** RTL: `ArrowRight`/`&rarr;` CTA icons don't mirror in HE/AR (prism, frosted, grid-ink, night-shift,
  prestige); easy-lane inline-icon `marginRight` doesn't flip.
- **L16** "Available once your site is published" tooltip hardcoded English on 6+ templates; nav aria-labels
  and "Go to top" hardcoded English on mumotor/aurora/obsidian.
- **L17** `NotFound.tsx`, the ProtectedRoute spinner, the notification bell, and the logo `aria-label` are
  not localized; Landing `<title>`/meta description hardcoded English.
- **L18** Report time in the 00:00 hour coerces the booking cutoff to 18 (`Number('00')||18`,
  `wizard.ts:312`, `BuilderWizard.tsx:307`).
- **L19** Same-day cutoff hour is UTC by design (default 18 = 8–9pm local) — documented, but a product smell.
- **L20** Dead/vestigial code: inline-booking CSS in open-road/grid-ink with no JSX; `contact.instagram`/
  `facebook` fields never read; `shiftStart`/`perDayHours` persisted but never read back; unused i18n keys.
- **L21** `sampleData.ts` still shows invented UK claims ("DVSA Approved (ADI)", "1,200 people") on the
  `/templates` gallery/preview (real published sites use the honest `dataDefaults`).
- **SPEC-1** Spec says Business description is "required"; product treats it as "Recommended" (only business
  name gates).
- **SPEC-2** Spec/docs claim numbers always stay Latin — true in render, but `formatWeekdayIn` omits the
  `latn` guard (harmless today).
- **SPEC-3** Instructor `bio` is only rendered by Bento (3 other read templates capture it but never show it).

# What is VERIFIED CORRECT (checked, no bug)

So the report isn't only a bug list — these were adversarially checked and held up:

- **Multi-tenant isolation:** every teacher route is ownership-gated; `loadEnrollment`/`loadStudentEnrollment`
  scoped by `{id, websiteId}`; `requireStudent` rejects a websiteId mismatch; bulk-email re-scopes
  `enrollmentIds` to the site. No IDOR found across students/bookings/reviews/messages/media/settings.
- **Double-booking:** genuinely closed at the DB level (partial unique index `Booking_slot_unique`) plus an
  in-transaction pre-check and `P2002 → 409` in **both** book and assign; cancel frees the slot.
- **Token security:** teacher/student JWT separation enforced bidirectionally; student token scoped to one
  site; secret required (fail-fast) in prod; bcrypt rounds 12; constant-time code comparison; one-time
  reset/verify tokens via atomic `getdel` with correct TTLs.
- **Rate limiting** on every public mutation; test bypass correct; fails open.
- **Reviews** only ever show `APPROVED`; never fabricated (sampleData reviews can't leak onto a real site);
  rating bounded 1–5.
- **Packages↔plans** single source of truth (`syncPackageOverrideToPlans` + `reconcilePackageOverride`)
  correct across multi-save/session; wired into both save paths.
- **Registry:** all 12 templates present and consistently wired; `COLOR_SLOTS` complete for all 12; backend
  `TEMPLATE_THEME` mirrors the frontend exactly.
- **Reviews/Gallery hidden when empty; account/book/enroll URLs wired on all 12.**
- **PWA/service worker cache contract** correct: `/api`, `/uploads`, `/site`, `*.webmanifest` never cached;
  navigations network-first; assets stale-while-revalidate; SW registers PROD-only.
- **i18n structure:** HE/AR typed as `typeof en` (build fails on a missing key); builder `builder.*` keys 0
  missing across all three; language persistence + `dir=rtl` correct.
- **Emails** are true fire-and-forget (never block the primary action); cancellation notifies the correct
  party in each direction; magic link + password reset + verification TTLs match their copy.
- **Analytics** milestone events are single-fire; `ensureDailyCode` is an idempotent upsert; `ENABLE_CRON`
  gating correct.
- **Delete-website** cascade is real for every child table + clears caches; type-DELETE confirm consistent
  front/back.
- **Billing** never grants a paid plan without Stripe (503 in prod); demo switch only outside prod.

# Wave 6 — Live runtime verification

The highest-risk findings were reproduced end-to-end against a **running server** (Postgres reset +
reseeded clean, API on :4000, route prefix `/api`) and a **real browser render** of the published site
(`/p/davids-driving`, template `mumotor`). **8 of 9 reproduced; 1 was downgraded.**

| # | Check | Verdict | Observed evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | Register requires phone (breaks wizard publish) | **CONFIRMED-LIVE** | no-phone → `400 {code:"VALIDATION_ERROR",details:{phone:["Required"]}}`; with phone → `201` |
| C2 | Student email-only login takeover | **CONFIRMED-LIVE** | `POST /student/login {email:"anna@example.com"}` → `200` + JWT; token on `/student/me` → full account |
| H8 | check-enrollment enumeration + name leak | **CONFIRMED-LIVE** | real email → `{enrolled:true,studentName:"Anna Krause"}`; random → `{enrolled:false}` |
| H1 | City duplicated on published site | **CONFIRMED-LIVE** | live DOM: contact text `"22 Herzl Street, Netanya, Netanya"`; JSON-LD `areaServed` has "Netanya" twice; two `.mm-area-name` chips both "Netanya" |
| H6 | "Lessons booked" tile counts cancelled | **CONFIRMED-LIVE** | booked → `_count.bookings` 2→3; cancelled that booking → still **3** |
| M1 | classCount double-counts / never decrements | **CONFIRMED-LIVE** | after book+cancel: `classCount:5` but real `stats.total:1` in the same `/student/me` response; `grep decrement` → 0 hits |
| M5 | public-availability ignores advanceBookingDays | **CONFIRMED-LIVE** | 30-days-out (site cap 14) → availability returns real slots; same date to `/book-lesson` → `400 ADVANCE_BOOKING_EXCEEDED` |
| M23 | Review-reply renders unstyled (all templates) | **CONFIRMED-LIVE** | live computed style on `.mm-review-reply`: `border-inline-start:0px`, `padding-inline-start:0px`, label `font-weight:400` — CSS `.mm-review-reply-reply` never matches |
| M17 | Enroll static code case-sensitivity | **DOWNGRADED** | lowercase `drive2026` → `401 INVALID_CODE`; exact `DRIVE2026` → `201`. The comparison is *correctly* case-sensitive (rejecting the wrong case is intended, not a bypass). The residual issue is only a UI inconsistency for **mixed-case** codes — see revised M17 below. |

Live verification thus **strengthened** every headline finding except M17, which was corrected.

# Appendix — method & coverage

- **Waves:** (1) backend correctness — auth, booking, multi-tenant, students/reviews/messages;
  (2) emails + cron/analytics; (3) wizard + Customize; (4) all 12 templates + shared pipeline;
  (5) dashboard + student pages + marketing/auth/PWA/i18n; (6) live spot-checks; (7) consolidation.
- **How verified:** every finding is backed by a `file:line` citation from a full read of the cited file;
  a subset was additionally executed (`tsx`) or confirmed live (Wave 6, marked **[LIVE]**).
- **Confidence tags in the source waves:** CONFIRMED = unambiguous from static code; PLAUSIBLE = reasoned
  from a code trace but not exercised live (M10, M4, and a few RTL items carry this tag).
- **Not exhaustively driven:** full click-through of all 12 templates × 3 languages was out of scope by
  agreement (many templates are near-duplicates); the shared pipeline + representative templates were read
  in full and the rest cross-checked.
